---
title: "Data"
---

Datasets used in the notes and slides, served from this site. Each dataset is
documented in the notes' [data appendix](notes/appendix_data.html) (what it is,
where it came from, and what the variables mean). Files are fetched from the
pinned `teaching-data` release; see `data_pin` in the site repo.

Right-click a link and choose "Save link as..." to download, or read it straight
into R, e.g. `read_csv("https://jaredsmurray.github.io/temba-stats-2026/data/returns/returns.csv")`.

- [`austin_houses.csv`](data/austin_houses/austin_houses.csv) (9 MB)
